proposals.before: Since Daowen fell ill the inner palace thrice sent attendants saying: Heaven summons you.
proposals.after: Since Daowen fell ill, the empress sent attendants three times to see me, saying, "His Majesty summons you."
proposals.reason: In this palace summons and account of imperial gift-giving, 天 is the ruler, as confirmed by 陛下 and 國家 in the surrounding letter, not a supernatural Heaven. Preserve the reported speech rather than turn it into a divine summons or retrospective claim about forcing wine.
